Anya: quick sync on the 'fast-then-accurate' bring-up for titan-14b quantized variants. sharing microbench notes and ops asks.
Ravi: short tl;dr?
Anya: two-phase speculative: a very cheap int4-ish fast path for prefix tokens, then a narrow q7 hotpath if low-confidence. aim is to cut tail latency for chat flows without blowing unit cost.
Lena: perf numbers?
Anya: bench on g5g xlarge, ctx 2048, batch 16: steady-state tokens/sec up ~1.9x vs q7-only. median token latency down 28% (22ms->16ms). 99th down ~18%.
Ravi: quality impact?
Anya: on a 2k validation slice: EM -0.9pp, ppl +0.9, faithfulness/hallucination +2.4pp. most errors in multi-hop QA and reasoning chains where early cheap tokens introduced a wrong branch.
Lena: curious if the mistakes are deterministic or stochastic.
Anya: mix: ~60% deterministic for given prompt, 40% stochastic. deterministic ones often stem from early numeric tokenization errors.
Ravi: can we try adaptive fallthrough where we always re-eval numerics and named entities on slow path?
Anya: yes proposal: entity_detector -> force_hotpath for tokens matching regex \b[A-Z][a-z]{2,}\b or numeric patterns. cheap to add.
Lena: any logs/artifacts?
Anya: s3://redwood-dev/eng-ml/spec-titan/1741234567/run1/
Anya: quick snapshot (2k):\n- baseline(q7): ppl 11.4 | EM 74.1% | hall 2.8%\n- speculative(int4->q7): ppl 12.3 | EM 73.2% | hall 5.2%
Ravi: plan?
Anya:
1) run 10k sweep with entity-forcing + layer-rescale transforms.
2) run staged canary at 2% with human spot-check of 100 failures.
3) fallback rule: if a token corrected within 2 tokens, treat as transient; else count as regression.
Lena: small ask: can we log token-level confidence + whether fallback fired? helps for confusion matrix.
Anya: yes will add debug field token_meta.confidence and fallback_reason in logs.
ci-bot: CI test for speculative policy config passed (unit tests + integration smoke).
Ravi: cool. schedule a brief sync after the 10k sweep completes. thanks everyone.
